# T227-SN1 - THE TRAP, and it is p225's openeducat trap in a THIRD shape.
# The root LICENSE DOES contain 'any later version', 3 times: lines 570, 572 and 638.
# Lines 570/572 are inside section 14, 'Revised Versions of this License' - the p225 shape.
# Line 638 is NEW: it is inside the appendix 'How to Apply These Terms to Your New Programs',
# the boilerplate NOTICE TEMPLATE, complete with the literal placeholders
# '<one line to give the program's name...>' and 'Copyright (C) <year> <name of author>'.
# Its subject is a HYPOTHETICAL FUTURE PROGRAM, not Open edX's grant. Counting it would have
# published AGPL-3.0-or-later on the largest platform on these shelves, across 65+9 cells.
# STANDING RULE (extends p225's): in a LICENSE file the project's own preamble is a channel;
# neither the canonical body NOR its how-to-apply appendix is one.
